description: Simple Macedonian Dynasty Build Order by Beasty
name: Simple Macedonian Dynasty - Beasty
author: Niki45nk

notes: 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ make 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@ on the side of @building_economy/town-center.webp@ near the @resource/berrybush.webp@
Rally 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@, 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@, then back to @resource/sheep.webp@
Put all @resource/sheep.webp@ on side of @building_economy/town-center.webp@ nearest to the @resource/berrybush.webp@
[Make sure its eco bonus radius extends to the 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@]
[If against Knight or Horse Civ, build @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ into @unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@ and @unit_macedonian/bogmadr-2.webp@]

When 8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, Rally @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 11 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
[Now you can either go into Feudal Rush to Age-Up to Castle Age]

Send 5 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and Rally to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 10 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@

6 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ in a forward position near @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ (if possible)
Upgrade your units and start making @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@

At spawn, 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@ | 1@unit_worker/villager.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@@building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@, not too close to TC (for farms) then send to @resource/sheep.webp@ | @resource/rally.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 2 then @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ until @age/age_2.webp@

If scout @resource/deer.webp@ immediately, go for it with 7 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ (then you avoid to be short in @resource/sheep.webp@), do it especially against slow civ, then send a 3rd @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Go @age/age_2.webp@  with 4@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ (@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@)| Send 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@) + @resource/rally.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 6 then @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ | @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@ | @abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ when possible
-If you can't do damage, just produce 1
-If you feel you can kill some @unit_worker/villager.webp@, go for 2-3
-If you want to put lot more pressure, go for 5-6

As soon as 2nd @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ is queued, send 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ until 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (No@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@) then @resource/resource_food.webp@| when 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, last @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from wood @abilities/repair.webp@@building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ + @building_economy/house.webp@ | Move 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and the rest to @resource/resource_food.webp@ (leave 2 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ if going for more @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ until number reached)
Once @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ done, get @technology_macedonian/scale-barding-2.webp@ ASAP | Keep @resource/rally.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@

When close to enough @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @age/age_3.webp@ (around 450@resource/resource_gold.webp@), move 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Age up to @age/age_3.webp@ ASAP, send 8 (10-12@unit_worker/villager.webp@ if getting pushed)@unit_worker/villager.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ around ressources like @resource/resource_gold.webp@, @resource/deer.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@
Get the military upgrades and the eco upgrades ASAP
Start to produce @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@ with @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ | Set @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@ on @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@
Build @building_religious/monastery.webp@ ASAP and go get @resource/relics.webp@ (protect @resource/relics.webp@ with @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@ if needed)
Once @resource/sheep.webp@ done, focus on @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/boar.webp@ or start slowly transition to @building_economy/farm.webp@ if struggle against mobile civ (like a cav civ)
Later on you can add @building_military/stable.webp@@building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ to produce more @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@

description: See video link for elaborate guide
name: Hippodrome Aggro Into Age 3 Timing (2026)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Pull 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ when u find @resource/deer.webp@
Now produce the units u need and secure boar + 2nd deer while harassing opponent
@building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ & prio upgrades for Cav Armor and Archer Dmg (if you have archers)
Around 9-10 mins you macro towards castle by pulling your woodline to gold :) See video for rest

Start with 5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ for 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, send the last @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ build @building_macedonian/varangian_warcamp.webp@
Next 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@, make 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@ on the side of your @resource/berrybush.webp@
Next 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ already chopped down, build a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ and a house once it's done
Click @age/age_2.webp@ with 4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ and build @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@

Next 11 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 16, produce 3 @unit_religious/monk-3.webp@ and 10@unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@, and use your @landmark_byzantines/cistern-of-the-first-hill-2.webp@ on 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@, 1 @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@
Add @unit_macedonian/bogmadr-2.webp@ to your composition and start upgrading them

description: Standard aggro. Play horsemen archer spear (tricomp) aggressively and age up to castle after your opponent and look for a lot of damage in feudal. In castle play riddari and archer.
name: Feudal Aggression Macedonians (DLC RELEASE VERSION)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: @building_military/stable.webp@ -> @building_macedonian/varangian_arsenal.webp@/@building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ (arsenal if opp isn't feudal or isn't opening units)
Start adding in a few @building_economy/farm.webp@ around @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ now. Potentially tower your berries or gold if they are in the front as well.

@age/age_3.webp@ finishes at 8:10. Age uppers go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
